title: Enrolment and Annual Fees in the Wanderlane Traveller Club
content:
**1. Fees the programme charges.** Two fees attach to a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier. The enrolment fee is the one-off fee to join at that tier directly rather than earn into it, stated in US dollars. The annual fee is the fee charged to hold the tier, stated in US dollars and charged for the year of holding.

**2. Who may be joined directly.** Direct paid entry is permitted at Wanderlane Titanium and at Wanderlane Ambassador. It is not permitted at Wanderlane Blue, Wanderlane Silver, Wanderlane Gold or Wanderlane Platinum.

**3. Invitation.** Wanderlane Ambassador is granted only where an invitation has been issued. No other tier of the programme requires an invitation.

**4. Schedule of fees and entry conditions.**

| Tier | Enrolment fee, USD | Annual fee, USD | Direct paid entry | Invitation required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 0.00 | 0.00 | not permitted | no |
| Wanderlane Silver | 0.00 | 0.00 | not permitted | no |
| Wanderlane Gold | 0.00 | 0.00 | not permitted | no |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 0.00 | 0.00 | not permitted | no |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 495.00 | 295.00 | permitted | no |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 1250.00 | 795.00 | permitted | yes |

**5. Reading the schedule.** The four tiers from Wanderlane Blue to Wanderlane Platinum carry no enrolment fee and no annual fee. The two fees are separate charges and are not alternatives to one another: a traveller joined directly at Wanderlane Titanium is charged the enrolment fee of 495.00 for joining and the annual fee of 295.00 for holding the tier, and a traveller joined directly at Wanderlane Ambassador is charged 1250.00 for joining and 795.00 for holding it.
